meta.title: TCM — Internal Operations Platform
meta.description: CRM + Project + Cost Control for TCM Targeted Marketing

desktopNotif.prompt: Turn on desktop/mobile notifications so you don't miss new activity in the app.
desktopNotif.blockedHint: Your browser is blocking notifications — enable them in the site settings if you want this.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.subtitle: TCM internal operations platform — system framework being built module by module.
dashboard.roadmapDesc: Following the agreed architecture: Foundation → ① Clients (in progress) → ② Bidding & Contract → ③ Project Management ↔ ⑧ Inventory → ④ Cost & Receivables → ⑤ Staff → ⑥ KPI/Bonus-Penalty → ⑦ Payroll.
dashboard.activeClientsSub: Active in CRM / total clients under management
dashboard.runningProjectsSub: Entered execution this month / total execution YTD
dashboard.cashflowHint: Current calendar month. Expected in / out = every open item due before month end, INCLUDING amounts already overdue.
dashboard.displayOnlyHint: Display only — no filtered list page for this metric yet

list.title: Clients
list.subtitle: Client list by owning team — each team sees only their own clients, except CEO/Admin roles.
list.empty: No clients match the current filter.
list.profileIncompleteHint: Missing tax code/address/bank account/industry/classification — needed before signing a contract.

concentration.title: Client concentration warning (FR-11)
concentration.desc: Clients at or above {pct}% of their team's invoiced revenue in {year}:

form.name: Client name
form.brandPlaceholder: Search or type a new brand
form.bankAccountPlaceholder: e.g. Vietcombank Can Tho - 0011001234567 - DHG Pharma JSC

detail.projectHistoryPending: Will appear once module ③ Project Management is complete.
detail.financePending: Will appear once module ④ Cost & Receivables is complete.
detail.transferDesc: Transfer this client to another Account team. Different from Project Handover — this changes the owning team for the entire client.
detail.careHint: Log an entry every time you meet/call/message the client — used to track care cadence.
detail.profileIncompleteBanner: Client profile is incomplete for contract signing
detail.profileIncompleteHintDetail: Complete this before moving a project to Processing (actual contract signing).

import.title: Import clients from Excel
import.subtitle: Import the real client list from the Sales Excel file (sheet "KH") — only PIC1 is read; linked projects are created automatically.
import.uploadDesc: Choose a .xlsx file in the expected format (sheet "KH", header on row 2). Click "Preview" to check before the real import.
import.doneSummary: Created {created} new clients, updated {updated} existing ones, {contacts} contacts, {projects} projects, {notes} care notes.
import.previewSummary: Found {clients} clients ({existing} already exist in the CRM and will only be filled in where blank), {projects} linked projects, {unassigned} clients without a team.
import.picReviewDesc: PIC 2/3/4 in the file are misaligned with their client rows — download this file to review manually (with a suggested client match by email domain), then add contacts yourself on each client's detail page.

careReport.title: Client care report
careReport.subtitle: Sorted by longest time without care — Active/Inactive clients only.
careReport.empty: No clients are overdue for care.

client.codeLength: Client code must be exactly 3 characters

index.title: System Settings
index.subtitle: Shared configuration — only Admin/CEO should have edit access.
index.teamsDesc: Add/edit/deactivate teams — controls row-level client visibility by team.
index.industryDesc: Industry list used when creating a client.
index.commissionDesc: Base/contract commission parameters for staff who refer new clients.
index.projectTypeDesc: Project type list for the Bidding module.
index.failReasonDesc: Reasons used when a project is lost.
index.biddingParamsDesc: Min margin, auto-approve threshold, document reminder cadence.
index.clientsParamsDesc: Max interval between care entries by client status.
index.projectStatusDesc: Project status list — edit labels or add extra statuses (no automated workflow gate).
index.timelineStatusDesc: Status list for each Master Timeline item (Not started / In progress / Blocked / Done).
index.creativeTaskTypeDesc: Task category list for the Creative module (Key visual, POSM, 3D Booth, Video...) — used for grouping & later cost calc.
index.costsheetTemplatesDesc: CO/CE template library by project type — sections, cost lines, proxy (Chi ho) section.
index.timelineTemplatesDesc: Timeline templates by project type (Gantt/Checklist) — scaffold projects quickly.
index.communicationDesc: Super-admin sees all groups, message refresh cadence.
index.staffDesc: Staff directory, create new accounts (date of birth required).
index.kbCategoryDesc: Add/edit/remove document groups (General/Credentials/ISO/HS&E...) for the Knowledge Base module.
index.creativeCostDesc: Review cycle, salary budget by position, allocation % matrix for the Creative module.
index.warehousesDesc: HCM main hub + sub-hubs, add/edit freely
index.inventoryCategoryDesc: Item category list for the Inventory module
index.shiftsDesc: Standard shift catalog for weekly scheduling
index.timekeepingDesc: Standard weekly hours, annual leave, carry-over deadline
index.rolesDesc: Assign an org-chart role to each staff member.
index.kpiDesc: Evaluation criteria, 75/25 pool parameters, position salaries
index.aiDesc: DeepSeek connection status and how to configure the API key.
index.departmentsDesc: Department lead and CO/CE cost-line prefix.
index.securityDesc: Change the shared password issued to new staff.

bidding.title: Bidding parameters
bidding.desc: Business thresholds for the Bidding & Contract module.
bidding.minMarginHint: Below this requires a CEO override with a reason.
bidding.thresholdHint: Below threshold & margin OK & not budget-down → auto-approved.
bidding.processingReminderHint: From entering In Progress, until Accounting confirms it's done.
bidding.liquidationReminderHint: Repeats until Accounting confirms all documents received.
bidding.orderResponseDaysHint: Prefills "Desired delivery timeline" = project creation date + this many days.

clients.title: Client care parameters
clients.desc: Max interval between care entries — overdue items show on the Reminders page.

teams.title: Account Teams
teams.desc: Teams control row-level client visibility. Don't hard-delete a team already linked to clients/projects — turn off "Active" to hide it from new selections instead.

options.title: Category: {name}
options.desc: Turn off "Active" instead of deleting if this item is already used by existing clients/projects.
options.errorRequired: Code and Vietnamese name are required.
options.errorCodeExists: Code "{code}" already exists in this category.

commission.title: Client referral commission
commission.desc: Reward parameters for the staff member who referred a new client. The system currently only stores these parameters — automatic calculation & payout will be built with module ⑥ KPI/Bonus-Penalty.
commission.baseHint: When the new client sends TCM their first brief.
commission.contractHint: When the new client signs their first contract (renewals excluded).
commission.errorBaseInvalid: Base commission must be a number ≥ 0.
commission.errorContractInvalid: Contract commission must be a number ≥ 0.

costsheetTemplates.title: CO/CE templates
costsheetTemplates.desc: Each project type should have one standard template — made of sections, each with cost lines.
costsheetTemplates.isProxySection: This is the Client Proxy Payments section

timelineTemplates.title: Master Timeline templates
timelineTemplates.desc: Each project type should have one template — choose a view mode (Gantt/Checklist) and visible columns.

finance.title: Finance settings (CFO)
finance.desc: Per-staff advance limits — checked across all projects.
finance.maxCountHint: Staff holding more than this must settle old advances before a new one.
finance.maxAmountHint: Outstanding total above this must be settled before a new advance.
finance.cashflowDesc: Number of weekly buckets (7 days each) then monthly buckets (30 days each) shown on /finance/cashflow. Can be changed anytime during operation.

creative.title: Creative cost-per-task
creative.desc: Salary by POSITION (not per individual) · planned allocation matrix · compared against actual hours at /creative/cost.
creative.cycleDesc: Changing the cycle does NOT convert past periods' numbers — each period keeps its own budget/matrix.
creative.salaryDesc: 1 row / position currently held by an active Creative staffer — position name is not free-typed.
creative.headcountOverrideHint: Leave blank = auto from active staff count. Fill in = lock for a closed period.
creative.orphanTitle: Orphan budgets (position no longer has active staff) — delete only, no edit:
creative.matrixDesc: % of each position's salary pool allocated to each task type. Sum does not have to be 100% — the system warns on mismatch, it never normalizes.
creative.noMatrix: Needs active positions and at least 1 task type (Settings → Creative task type) to build the matrix.

communication.title: Internal chat
communication.desc: Configure the communication channel (super-admin, refresh cadence).
communication.superAdminTitlesHint: Titles allowed to view all group chats (comma-separated). e.g. CEO, BD Director.
communication.pollSecondsHint: How often new messages auto-load while a conversation is open. Default 4 seconds.

staff.title: Staff
staff.desc: TCM staff directory — new accounts require a date of birth and first work date.
staff.firstWorkDateHint: First work date at TCM — DD/MM/YYYY format (can differ from the CRM account creation date)
staff.errorRequired: Please fill in full name and email.
staff.errorDobFormat: Invalid date of birth — use DD/MM/YYYY format.
staff.errorFirstWorkDateFormat: Invalid first work date — use DD/MM/YYYY format.
staff.deleteWarning: This permanently deletes the staff record and directly linked data (notifications, project members, chat group memberships, shift assignments...). This cannot be undone.
staff.deleteConfirmPlaceholder: Type the full name exactly to confirm
staff.errorCannotDeactivateSelf: You cannot deactivate the account you're currently signed in as.
staff.errorCannotDeleteSelf: You cannot delete the account you're currently signed in as.
staff.errorLastAdmin: This is the last active Admin — cannot deactivate/delete.

warehouses.title: Warehouses & locations
warehouses.subtitle: HCM main hub + flexible sub-hubs — add/edit freely
warehouses.errorHasStock: Cannot deactivate: the warehouse still has stock or a pending incoming transfer.

shifts.title: Work shifts
shifts.subtitle: Standard shift catalog (4h each) — department heads pick shifts when scheduling

timekeeping.title: Timekeeping parameters
timekeeping.weekHoursHint: 40h/week baseline — the grid shows green when staff reach this total.
timekeeping.annualLeaveDaysHint: Standard yearly quota; mid-year joiners are prorated monthly.
timekeeping.carryoverDeadlineHint: Last year's unused leave is usable until this date next year (default 03-31).

roles.title: Roles & Permissions
roles.subtitle: Assign roles to staff in the first tab; configure what each role group may do in the Permission matrix tab.
roles.catalogHint: Director/Manager → Staff hierarchy across 10 groups — used as the assignment options above.
roles.matrixHint: Checked = that role group may perform the action. Unchecking blocks it for real, on both the page and the server action — not just hiding a button.
roles.adminAllAccessHint: The Admin group always holds every permission — hard-wired in code so nobody can lock themselves out of this page.

kpi.title: KPI Settings
kpi.subtitle: Evaluation criteria, 75/25 pool parameters and position salaries.
kpi.criteriaDesc: Criteria are built up over time — add/edit/deactivate (no hard delete to keep history). AUTO criteria prefill suggested scores from CRM data.
kpi.paramsDesc: Phase 1 zero-sum: floor = cap = 1.0 (margin factor neutralized). Lower the floor factor to make the pool elastic to margin.
kpi.poolPercentHint: Share of salary pooled and split by score (default 25%).
kpi.floorFactorHint: 1.0 = zero-sum (pool always full). Lower it (e.g. 0.7) to scale the pool with margin.
kpi.emptyWindowFactorHint: Applied to teams with no finished projects in the window — seasonal, may be adjusted monthly.
kpi.salariesDesc: Full salary per position × department — no per-person salaries stored. A newer period row overrides older ones from its effective period.
kpi.noSalaries: No salary rows for this period yet.

departments.title: Departments
departments.desc: Department lead (schedules the week, approves Planning proposals) and the CO/CE cost-line prefix. Department codes are fixed; changing them needs a migration.
departments.errPrefixTaken: That prefix is already used by {name}.

security.title: Security
security.desc: The shared password issued to new staff and on admin reset.
security.defaultPasswordHint: Used for first login or after an admin reset — the system forces a change straight after. Does not affect anyone who already set their own password.
security.stillFactoryDefault: Still using the factory default password. Change it before opening the system company-wide.
security.errTooShort: Password must be at least {min} characters.
security.errMismatch: The two entries do not match.
security.usingDefaultCount: {count} active staff have not set their own password yet — they use this shared password.

list.title: Bidding & Contract
list.subtitle: Projects in bidding / quoting — by owning team.
list.empty: No projects match the current filter.

complexity.simpleHint: Client has the concept — TCM only executes
complexity.mediumHint: Needs partial idea support from TCM
complexity.complexHint: Client only briefs — TCM creates concept + proposal

new.title: New project intake
new.name: Project name
new.ownerTeamPending: Awaiting BGĐ to assign Account team
new.budgetHint: Fill when client gives a total budget (budget-down)

detail.assignTeamDesc: This project is awaiting BGĐ to choose an Account team.
detail.mobileFullDetailNote: Full master timeline/CO-CE details are available on desktop.

order.title: Order to Related Departments
order.desc: Send internal requests before building CO/CE — tick "Yes" for any department needed and fill in the details below.
order.briefLinkLabel: Brief link received from the client
order.acceptNote: If you don't agree with this task or timeline, please contact {name} right away to discuss and align. Thank you!
order.resultLinkPlaceholder: Google Drive/OneDrive link with the finished result...

costsheet.title: CO/CE (CECO ctract)
costsheet.none: No CO/CE sheet yet. Create one to start quoting.
costsheet.mgmtFeePctHint: Applied on direct CO total — adds to internal cost (CO).
costsheet.contingencyPctHint: Applied on direct CO total — adds to internal cost (CO).
costsheet.discountPctHint: Only used when deriving a suggested CE from CO — does not affect the margin gate.
costsheet.makeupHint: Apply markup to meet min margin, keep locked lines & caps — excludes % lines and the proxy section.
costsheet.rejectNoteRequired: A reason is required to reject
costsheet.overrideNote: Reason for going below the margin floor (sent to the approver)
costsheet.autoApproved: Eligible for auto-approve (below threshold & margin OK)
costsheet.sectionDepartmentHint: Sets the code prefix for every line in this section (e.g. OPE-001). Codes are auto-assigned on save.
costsheet.overrideNotePlaceholder: Reason for approving below the margin floor…
costsheet.agencyFeePctHint: Presentation-only on the exported quotation (lines → +fee → +VAT). Does not affect margin.
costsheet.colSponsoredHint: Quotation shows the unit price but charges nothing for this line (line CE = 0). CO still counts.

result.title: Bid result & handoff
result.blockedFr04: Cannot move: need email confirmation OR PO number OR a signed contract (FR-04).
result.blockedNeedContractDone: Cannot move: Accounting must confirm "Contract done" first.
result.blockedNeedAcceptanceDocs: Cannot finish: Accounting must confirm "Acceptance docs complete" first.
result.blockedIncompleteProfile: Can't sign contract yet — client profile is missing: {fields}. Complete it on the client page.
result.blockedNeedInvoice: No invoice has been issued for this project — cannot finish. Issue the invoice on the Liquidation tab first.

validation.briefLinkRequired: Enter a valid link (starting with http/https)
validation.failReasonNoteRequired: A specific reason is required when "Other" is selected
validation.marginBlocked: Margin below {pct}% — needs CEO override with a reason.
validation.overrideNoteRequired: A reason is required when overriding margin.
validation.goNogoRequired: A Go/No-Go (GO) decision is required before building CO/CE.
validation.overrideNotAllowed: You do not have permission to set margin below the minimum floor. Contact an authorised approver.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.subtitle: Overdue items to action — computed from thresholds configured in Settings.
reminders.kindProcessing: In progress — contract not confirmed done
reminders.acceptanceEmpty: No projects overdue on the expected acceptance sign-off date.
reminders.inventoryEmpty: No issue documents are overdue for return.

list.title: Project Management
list.subtitle: Projects in execution — by owning team. Bidding stays in module ②.

detail.rolesDesc: Owner (senior Account) approves · Leader (Account) runs the daily timeline.
detail.mobileFullDetailNote: The full Master Timeline is best managed on desktop.

timeline.title: Internal Master Timeline
timeline.desc: Build the internal timeline (Phase → Task). Pick items to share to the External view.
timeline.templatePickerDesc: Pick a template by project type to quickly scaffold Phase → Item → Task.
timeline.noTemplate: No template matches this project type yet.
timeline.applyTemplateHint: This ADDS the template's sections to the current timeline (existing data kept).
timeline.staffingDesc: Rows = roles, columns = activity zones, cells = headcount (KUN checklist style).

guestInvite.title: Invite client to timeline (magic-link)
guestInvite.desc: Create an invite link for the client PIC to open the Guest Portal.
guestInvite.copyHint: Copy the link and send it to the client. The token is not shown again after you leave.

orders.title: Department ORDERs
orders.desc: Auto-collected from Master Timeline PICs into draft orders per department. Review/edit then Send.
orders.refreshHint: Re-collect timeline items by each PIC's department (does not send).
orders.empty: No ORDERs yet. Assign PICs to timeline items then click "Refresh ORDERs from Timeline".
orders.dispatchHint: Send to this department's staff (Creative auto-spawns tasks).

coce.title: CO/CE (Cost & Quote)
coce.desc: CO/CE carried down from Bidding — edit it directly here. Each save creates a revision (see history below).
coce.noSheet: This project has no CO/CE yet.
coce.noSheetHint: Go to the Bidding workspace to build the CO/CE for this project.
coce.noChanges: The two revisions are identical — no changes.
coce.goNogoBlocked: Project is awaiting a Go/No-Go decision — CO/CE cannot be edited yet.
coce.sendToLiquidationHint: Send the current CO/CE revision to the Liquidation tab for client sign-off. You can keep editing and resend if a last-minute change is needed.
coce.sentToLiquidationInfo: Sent v{rev} to Liquidation at {date} · by {name}
coce.sentToLiquidationNone: No revision has been sent to Liquidation yet.

liquidation.title: Liquidation & Handover
liquidation.desc: Accountant confirmations, acceptance docs and final status transitions. Full actions live in the Bidding workspace.
liquidation.onlyExecutionNote: Applies to execution projects only (Processing → Liquidation → Finished).
liquidation.liquidNote: CECO Liquid (detailed acceptance sheet) will be added in a later batch.
liquidation.coceSnapshotEmpty: No CO/CE has been sent to Liquidation yet.
liquidation.coceSnapshotHint: Go to the CO/CE tab and click "Send to Liquidation" to send the latest revision here.
liquidation.expectedSignDateHint: The system will remind the Project Leader/Owner when this date passes without client confirmation.
liquidation.staleRevWarning: The cost sheet has a newer revision (v{latest}) than the one sent to liquidation (v{sent}). Figures below are the older version.
liquidation.invoiceNeedSentRev: No cost sheet revision has been sent to liquidation yet — there is no baseline to check the invoice amount against.
liquidation.errRequired: Enter an invoice number and a valid amount.
liquidation.errNoSentRev: No cost sheet revision has been sent to liquidation to check against.
liquidation.errExceedBillable: Exceeds the amount left to invoice on cost sheet v{rev} ({remaining} remaining).
liquidation.ctvVarianceWarning: The cost sheet still holds plan figures: entered CTV (BM08) is {direction} the matching cost lines by {amount} đ. Update the cost sheet with actuals (new revision) before closing, or the margin will be wrong.

operations.title: Operations — Outsourced Labor (CTV)
operations.desc: Import the outsourced-labor payment sheet (BM08), review/edit on the grid, then generate each person's agreement.
operations.noBatches: No outsourcing batches for this project yet.
operations.deleteBatchConfirm: Delete this entire batch? This cannot be undone.
operations.importHint: Choose the "Outsourced labor payment sheet" (BM08/QT.TCM.16), sheet BM8_TT.
operations.importReplaceWarning: Importing will REPLACE all existing rows in this batch with data from the new file.
operations.noRows: No rows yet — import an Excel file or click "+ Add row".
operations.generateHint: Generates one filled agreement (.docx) per person from the BM06/BM09 template — save your edits first.
operations.generateConfirm: Generate agreements for all {count} CTV in this batch?
operations.mobileNote: View the full grid on a computer.
operations.noCostLines: This project has no cost lines to link CTV rows to — open Finance and press "Refresh" to sync from the cost sheet first.
operations.defaultCostLine: Batch default cost line (rows without their own link count into this line)
operations.cmpHint: Plan = the line's net (actually-paid-out) amount. CTV = money handed to recipients per BM08 (Gross rows use Net received). Updates as you type, including unsaved rows.
operations.cmpProxyNote: Client-paid (outside cost of sales, per-line caps):
operations.cmpUnassigned: Not linked to any cost line: {amount} đ — link each row or set the batch default before requesting payment.
operations.payHint: Creates one scheduled voucher per cost line in Vendor Payments — accounting transfers per BM08 then marks paid.
operations.paySuccess: Created {count} vouchers, total {total} đ. Accounting has been notified.
operations.payAlreadyCreated: Payment for this batch was already requested. Cancel the old vouchers in Vendor Payments first to request again.
operations.payUnassigned: {amount, number} đ is not linked to any cost line — link everything before requesting payment.
operations.payNothing: No rows carry an amount to pay.
operations.payStaleLine: Cost line "{item}" is stale (cost sheet changed) — press Refresh in Finance and re-link.
operations.payOverCap: CTV exceeds the cap on: {items}. Someone with the over-cap permission must request this.
operations.payOverCapReason: CTV exceeds the cap on: {items} — a reason is required.
operations.payProjectNotExecuting: Project is not in an execution stage — payment cannot be requested.

planning.title: Planning
planning.desc: Receives the brief from Account → Research → Design brief → Proposal (multiple review rounds) → confirm FINAL and hand back to Account.
planning.noJob: This project has no Planning job yet.
planning.noJobHint: Go to the ORDER tab and send an ORDER to the Planning department — a job will auto-generate with the brief link.
planning.applyToRemaining: Also assign this person to the remaining unfinished stages (one person runs the whole flow)
planning.hoursHint: Hours, minimum 0.25h, enter in multiples of 0.25 (e.g. 0.25 / 0.5 / 1.75).
planning.proposalNotAssignedYet: The Proposal stage hasn't been assigned yet — assign it above before submitting a version.
planning.requestRevisionNote: Feedback for the next revision round (required)
planning.confirmFinalConfirm: Confirm version {no} as the FINAL PROPOSAL? The system will automatically send this link to the Account who ORDERed and this job can no longer be edited.
planning.confirmFinalHint: The final version is automatically sent to the Account who ORDERed, with a notification.
planning.lockedFinal: Job locked — FINAL PROPOSAL already confirmed.
planning.lockedCancel: Job locked — the project was canceled/failed.
planning.mobileNote: View the full details on a computer.

deptTasks.title: Internal tasks
deptTasks.subtitle: Tasks auto-generated from the Master Timeline/Order — assigned down to individual staff, tracked to completion.
deptTasks.mobileFullDetailNote: The full task board works best on a computer.
deptTasks.leadNoApproval: No lead approval needed (deliver straight to the orderer)
deptTasks.finishedGraceOpen: Project completed — remember to save the result to the local server ({days} days left).

guest.invalidBody: This invite link has expired or been revoked. Please contact your Account team.

creative.title: Creative
creative.subtitle: Manage tasks sent to the Creative team — realtime figures.
creative.mobileFullDetailNote: The full task board is best used on desktop.

cost.title: Creative cost-per-task
cost.subtitle: Planned (% matrix) vs Actual (hour-based allocation) — by position, by period.
cost.allocationNote: ⚠ The "Actual" column is an ALLOCATION of the salary pool by recorded hours, NOT extra money spent — salary is paid regardless of tasks.
cost.varianceNote: ⚠ Variance at the position level is always ≈ 0 by construction — meaningful variance lives in individual cells (position × type) and in the By task type table below.
cost.noBudgetDesc: No salary budget yet for period {period}.
cost.warnNoRatios: {positionTitle}: no allocation matrix yet — 100% of the pool has no planned allocation.
cost.warnNoBudget: {positionTitle}: {count} task(s) delivered this period but NO salary budget set (counted as 0đ).
cost.warnMissingHours: {count} delivered task(s) missing hours — actual cost-per-task may be understated.
cost.warnMissingType: {count} delivered task(s) missing a task type — hours still count toward the total; see the "Untyped" row.
cost.warnMissingAssignee: {count} delivered task(s) have no assignee — cannot attribute to any position.
cost.warnOrphanBudget: {positionTitle}: has a budget but no active staff left — see "Orphan budgets" in Settings.
cost.matrixDetailDesc: Open each position to see planned% vs actual% and cost per task type.
cost.untypedRow: Untyped: {amount} (hours from tasks with no task type)

dashboard.staleLocked: {count} task(s) on closed projects — still active but NOT counted above (project is locked).

task.cdNoApproval: CD approval not required (send straight to orderer)
task.finishedGraceOpen: Project finished — remember to archive deliverables to the local server ({days} days left).

advances.title: Project execution advances
advances.desc: CO (internal cost) synced from CO/CE. Request advances per line; total never exceeds the line value.
advances.refreshedInfo: Synced version v{rev} · {updated} updated, {added} added, {staled} off new version
advances.staleAdvanceWarning: ⚠ {count} line(s) were renamed/removed in CO/CE but still carry {amount}đ of historical advances — reconcile before advancing again on a renamed line (avoid double-advancing).
advances.noSheet: Project has no CO/CE to sync. Build CO/CE in Project Management first.
advances.noProject: Select an execution project to view CO and advances.
advances.hardCopyNotice: Please complete the advance procedure with a hard copy at the Accounting dept.
advances.errBlockedCount: Exceeds allowed advance count for this staff ({count}/{max}) — settle old advances first.
advances.errBlockedAmount: Exceeds outstanding advance total for this staff ({amount}/{max}) — settle old advances first.
advances.errRequired: Please enter amount + recipient + bank transfer info.
advances.netVsCoHint: Net payable (spending cap). CO after tax gross-up: {co}đ — the difference is tax the company remits, not paid to anyone.
advances.outdatedWarning: Cost lines came from an older cost sheet (rev {synced}) while the sheet is now at rev {current}. Per-line amounts — and the spending caps based on them — may be wrong. Click "Refresh" to re-sync.
advances.errReverseReason: A reason is required to reverse a disbursed advance.
advances.errReverseWrongStatus: Only advances in Disbursed status can be reversed.
advances.errStaleLine: This cost line is no longer in the latest CO/CE — cannot request an advance.
advances.errProjectNotExecuting: This project is no longer in execution — cannot request an advance.
advances.reverseNotePlaceholder: Reason for reversing a disbursed advance…

vendorPayments.title: Vendor payments
vendorPayments.desc: Payment vouchers to vendors by project. Mark paid when done.
vendorPayments.costLineNone: No line with remaining budget in this project
vendorPayments.costLineHint: Linking a line makes this payment share that line spending cap with its advances. Leave blank for a project-level payment with no per-line cap.
vendorPayments.errRequired: Select a vendor and enter an amount.
vendorPayments.errExceedLine: Total spend exceeds the cost line value ({remaining} remaining).
vendorPayments.errLineNotFound: That cost line no longer exists — refresh CO/CE.
vendorPayments.errAlreadyPaid: This voucher is already marked as paid.
vendorPayments.errProjectRequired: Select the project this payment belongs to.
vendorPayments.errExceedProject: Exceeds the project spending cap ({remaining} remaining). Requires an over-cap approver.
vendorPayments.errOverCapReason: This payment exceeds the project cap ({remaining} remaining) — a reason is required.
vendorPayments.errNoCostLines: This project has no cost lines yet (CO/CE not built or not synced) so there is no cap to check against. Requires an over-cap approver.
vendorPayments.errNoCostLinesReason: This project has no cost lines to check against — a reason is required.
vendorPayments.overCapNoteHint: Only required when the payment exceeds the project cap, or the project has no cost lines yet.
vendorPayments.projectNoLines: No cost lines on this project — needs over-cap permission plus a reason.
vendorPayments.errReverseReason: A reason is required to un-mark as paid.
vendorPayments.errReverseWrongStatus: This voucher is not in Paid status.
vendorPayments.errCancelReason: A reason is required to cancel the voucher.
vendorPayments.errCancelWrongStatus: Only unpaid vouchers can be canceled. Un-mark the payment first.

debt.title: Client receivables (AR)
debt.desc: Client invoices → payments received → outstanding + aging buckets.
debt.errRequired: Select a project, enter an invoice number and a valid amount.
debt.errOverPayment: Payment exceeds the invoice balance ({outstanding} remaining).
